about_the_game:
You're panting, your heart pounding so fast, adrenaline in your blood, aren't you... Scared? Waking up with no memories and no purpose, lost in your own head, what will you choose - to learn the truth about yourself or to remain in ignorance? Does it matter who are you, man or woman, adult or child? Find out what is this place and what happened here. Become a detective, putting together the puzzle of the past story, become the one who will shed light on the shadow...

This demo version is showing created gameplay mechanics and part of the story.

Why you might like this game:
  • Orginal sountrack brimming with atmospere and personality
    Puzzles
  • Gameplay mechanics for full immersion
  • Notes revealing the personalities of all the characters
  • Deep and soulful story
  • Write your investigation together with...
  • Play at 4:3 resolution for more realism
  • Always ringing phone, is anybody there?
  • Who is your friend?
Developer's Note:
Who I am: Remedy is a game in the horror-detective genre. Creating this project, I was inspired by a lot of horror games, studied the pros and cons and decided to build that atmosphere, a game that would play with the player, crush, mock and be unpredictable. I made a soundtrack that fully captures the atmosphere of every moment. I just want to put a piece of my soul into this game. The game will ask you questions and give you answers - you have to see, hear and understand them.

content_descriptors.notes: Some content may be unpleasant or intimidating.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 ／ Processor Intel i5 9600K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 1660 Super 6 GB / 5600 XT 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6300 MB available space

short_description: Demo version of the future detective-horror game Who Am I: Remedy. Solve puzzles, read notes, enjoy original soundtrack, don't forget to pick up the phone and finally, answer the question "Who am I?".
